recent.text: The Leafs just look old. Bobrovsky looks old. Tavares looks old. Tanev looks old. OEL looks old. Stolarz can't play three games in a row. McCabe's game has taken a step back. Nylander isn't the same guy (not sure if that's age related). Paul doesn't look like his prime self.
recent.author: Kevin Papetti

recent.text: Anything you want to do differently? Sergei Bobrovsky: "No, not really. I've been preparing myself & been working all my life. I know exactly what kind of game I demand from myself. Again, I don't think you have to go too deep. It's just inch here, inch there & we gonna be fine"
recent.author: Mark Masters

recent.text: Auston Matthews: "The most frustrating part is that I feel like we have what it takes to be a really good team. We have a group that wants to compete every night and do the right things. But actions speak louder than words."
